title: Spicy Ethiopian Tibs
description: A traditional Ethiopian stir-fry dish made with marinated meat and spices. Serve with injera or rice for a flavorful meal.
instructions: 1. Cut the gored into small pieces and marinate in Bekam spice blend, niter kibbeh, red pepper flakes, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
2. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the marinated gored and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the onion, garlic, and tomato to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are softened.
5. Stir in the remaining Bekam spice blend and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
6. Serve the tibs hot with injera or rice and garnish with additional gored if desired.
